connector.name: Wavix
connector.registryDescription: Hosted MCP server for the Wavix telecom platform: SMS, voice, 2FA, SIP, numbers, 10DLC, CDRs.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.wavix.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the wavix account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token containing the user's Wavix API key. Obtain one at https://wavix.com under Administration → API keys.
